procedure: Opened actual operator PNGs through view_image; no generated or substituted screenshots. All images are full-page captures at DOM-reported 1280x800 DPR1; fixed/sticky chrome follows captured scroll location.

inspected.finding: Readable entry card and CTA, banner at viewport bottom.
Distinct introduction heading, descriptive content and Start CTA; banner crosses lower privacy copy.
Question/answer hierarchy readable; content extends below viewport; fixed banner intersects lower answer content.
Help expands with explanatory sections; summary has visible gold focus indicator.
Help collapsed and summary focus ring visible.
Focused Back is at lower left below question card; only upper edge of focus ring visible above cookie banner; label concealed.
Introduction restored with heading in view and Start visible.
Close has distinct visible gold focus ring; not concealed by bottom banner in this capture.
Exact same bytes as request2 Back-focus PNG; label and most ring concealed by banner.
First question visible again with help collapsed.

finding_limit: No viewport-only capture, bounding rectangles, scroll offsets or hit testing exposed. The overlap conclusion is restricted to the repeated full-page capture states; precise runtime overlap dimensions and behavior after dismissing cookies are unmeasured. Not a claim of a keyboard trap or WCAG certification.
